notes.title: Bob's Art Table Tracks + Two new exciting game modes!
notes.content:
Prepare for the most vibrant racing expansion yet: 'Colorful Tracks'! 

Experience the thrill of the chase with two exciting game modes: 'Last One Out' and 'Chased'. Outmaneuver your opponents to be the last racer standing or racing against each other while being pursued by The Smoke of Death!

Click the image below to learn more about the DLC.👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781711/d52ed218d69cdbb6315f73a99694e2f9ae8ab6a5.png

Help us to keep the race going!  🏎️💨
By purchasing the DLC, you will support our efforts to generate additional content in the future. As you can see from the roadmap below, we have huge plans for Event Race.  We wish to continuously make the game better and better, while releasing a new content (Both free and DLC). To summarize: By investing in Bob's Art Table Tracks, you also help ensure future updates and improvements. 💪

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781711/273741129700fb8ef9cdaeb6e1fdf119f9126ada.png

notes.title: Event Race - Game updates for January and February
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781711/e46d7446b3df937af8d4fb7037db3a987446b211.png

+ Improve the core game with updates, bug fixes, and new content: The first update will be later this month and will include things like new tracks, keyboard support, new mechanics, and more. For update number 2, we will aim to release this in early February, just in time for the "Remote Play Together" Steam event!

+ Release small and inexpensive DLC to coincide with different events: The income from these DLCs will mainly serve to help us keep the lights on while we continue to develop Event Race. The first DLC will be for Valentine's Day and will therefore be a great opportunity if you want to show Event Race some love!

+ We want to foster an open dialogue with our racers: Do you have some good ideas for a future update? A theme for a track? A mechanic you would like to see? Any ideas for unique game modes? Then drop by our Discord or Steam Community Hub! We would love to hear from you!


Want more details? Then we would like to invite you to check out the roadmap below! 👇 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781711/cb23f36967c9c118c74d12e0ebeaa61b2c55992b.png
